articles.summary: Pharmaceutical executive brings 20 years of clinical, commercial and operational leadership BOSTON, Mass., September 14, 2020 – Atea Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery and development of next- generation therapeutics for severe viral infections, today announced the appointment of Polly Murphy, D.V.M., Ph.D., Chief Business Officer of UroGen Pharma, to its Board […]
